agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A repository script that imports sibling scripts must bootstrap the repository root before package imports when invoked directly.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first direct validator invocation raised ImportError because the scripts package import preceded repository-root sys.path insertion.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The direct evidence-generation command failed before writing evidence and before any Node, Harness or provider activity.

correction.action: Insert the repository root into sys.path before importing the accepted sibling diagnosis module.
correction.prevention_control: Use the repository's established direct-script import bootstrap for every new sibling-importing CLI.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected direct-script import order and repository-root bootstrap correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Post-repair surrounding tests must exclude exact historical digest and consumed-latch selectors whose frozen assertions are intentionally superseded without rewriting them.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first surrounding packet included two consumed controller-digest selectors and one consumed attempt-004 latch selector, producing three expected historical-state failures.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest reported the two component_digest_mismatch failures and one active_operation_latch_mismatch while every other selected control passed.

correction.action: Record the three exact historical selectors, preserve their artifacts unchanged and rerun all 66 remaining surrounding selectors successfully.
correction.prevention_control: Create the historical-state test selection from the frozen source/latch delta before the first post-successor surrounding packet.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected historical-state selector mix and exact preservation-aware test selection.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every transactional decision source must already exist in the candidate repository; a register revision generated by the same prospective tick cannot serve as its own prepublication decision source.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first dry-run intent bound the contained-incident decision to the future revision-590 Markdown path; after that coordinate was corrected, the second draft still carried the same future path inside each prospective incident's evidence list; after both references were corrected, the third draft had not yet pre-authored the required revision reading.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Three governance clockwork dry runs rejected the future path at transaction preparation, then at incident-register projection, then reported the missing revision reading; canonical state remained unchanged throughout.

correction.action: Bind the decision and every prospective incident evidence path to already present candidate evidence, then pre-author the next revision reading with the exact prospective incident IDs before the clockwork dry run.
correction.prevention_control: Treat register closeout as a typed three-part template: existing evidence bindings, pre-authored next revision reading, and prospective canonical projection.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the three rejected register-closeout shapes and typed existing-evidence plus pre-authored-reading correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every edited closeout intent must pass JSON parsing immediately before any clockwork invocation.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: A patch that broadened the register-closeout correction omitted one comma between prevention_control and evidence_paths, so the next check stopped at JSON decoding.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork CLI failed during intent loading with JSONDecodeError before transaction preparation or canonical state change.

correction.action: Restore the missing comma and run json.tool before the next clockwork check.
correction.prevention_control: Parse and schema-check the intent after every patch, not only after its initial creation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected malformed intent patch and immediate JSON-validation control.
